rules.contract_term: Below 100 MW: the greater of 10 years and 5 years plus the load ramp period; 100 MW or more: the greater of 15 years and 10 years plus the load ramp period. After the term, automatic one-year extensions unless the customer gives written notice at least 24 months before termination
rules.collateral: Dedicated Facilities: advance funds equal to the estimated total cost as CIAC within 60 days of the LA. Transmission Network Upgrades: a letter of credit equal to the estimated total cost within 60 days of the ESA, reduced ratably once a year after three consecutive billing months at 75% of full contract demand. Security equal to the liquidated damages for early termination, in cash, letter of credit or parent guarantee, or a combination, as the Company requires
rules.exit_fee: Liquidated damages for early termination: 100% of minimum billing demand charges at annual contract demand and Extra Facilities Charges during the notification period, plus the net present value of remaining Extra Facilities Charges, plus 25% of remaining minimum billing demand charges after the notification period. Notification period: below 250 MW 24 months; 250 to 499 MW 36 months; 500 MW or more 48 months. After the 6th anniversary of service, a one-time reduction of up to 20% (no more than 200 MW) without liquidated damages. On early termination the Company draws the network upgrade letter of credit for the remaining net book value
